name: China Research Data Service Platform (CNRDS)
reason: Several official entries use it as a path to obtain or as an alternative commercial library, but there is no independent grounding record yet
next_action: Verify by product module, without generalizing the entire platform into a single dataset

name: RESSET database
reason: This major business-data platform appears in aliases and related-dataset notes but lacks module-level identity and access evidence
next_action: Verify the main modules, subscription scope, export route, and linkable identifiers

name: CEIC database
reason: This important source of macroeconomic and industry time series lacks a China-product-level record
next_action: Verify the relevant China products, frequencies, download limits, subscription route, and identifiers

name: Records of local environmental law enforcement and penalties in China
reason: Axbard & Deng uses new geocoded enforcement data; It cannot be incorporated into enterprise emissions or air quality monitoring
next_action: Read the paper data section/replication package to confirm the source, coverage, variables, and availability

name: Chinese government procurement and bidding data
reason: Public finance, government-enterprise relations, and innovative procurement are important gaps
discovered_from: Progress snapshots and ReStud paper clues
next_action: Verify the public fields, bulk acquisition, and commercial compilation versions of the China Government Procurement Network

name: China Minimum Wage Policy Panel (specific reusable product not yet identified)
reason: The minimum-wage household-finance benchmark idea lacks a joinable policy-timing product; household surveys and yearbooks cannot supply it automatically
next_action: Locate official labor-authority releases or a verifiable replication dataset with effective dates, standard types, administrative codes, and version provenance; do not publish until a reusable product boundary is established

name: China Local Talent Policy Panel (specific reusable product not yet identified)
reason: Talent-policy and household-education ideas lack verifiable regional treatment timing; news articles or undocumented hand-built lists are not a general panel
next_action: Locate a reusable list or replication dataset with policy definition, implementation level, effective date, regional code, and public provenance, then compare its years with candidate outcome surveys

name: Data on the implementation date of China's teacher rotation policy (specific data products to be positioned)
reason: Research on tutoring, parental participation, and educational expectations for teacher rotation lacks county/district records on timing and intensity of these measures.
next_action: First, confirm the policy level, implementation definition, county/district code, start and end dates, and documents or materials that can be rechecked; Do not generalize provincial initiatives to the actual implementation of each county.

name: Survey on Platform Workers and New Employment Forms in China (Specific Waves to Be Pinpointed)
reason: Current general household surveys cannot reliably identify food delivery riders, ride-hailing drivers, or platform algorithm exposures; This is the core gap of the digital labor idea.
next_action: Identify the specific survey organizer, sampling frame, wave, platform occupation identification variables, acquisition conditions, and whether public applications are allowed; Internet usage or general flexible employment variables cannot replace platform labor identification.

name: China Rural E-commerce Entry and Operator Data (specific product not yet identified)
reason: Research on rural e-commerce entry and household education pathways lacks joinable industry-entry and operator data
next_action: Distinguish regional e-commerce policies, platform transactions, online-store operators, household internet use, and general entrepreneurship; publish only after identity, acquisition, and spatial-temporal coverage are grounded
